title: JobUpdatedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'job.updated'. Emitted at job-ledger status transitions (queued→active→completed/failed) so the admin jobs dashboard is live via the events socket instead of polling (STATE.md P4.13, Phase 4 deliverable D). Deliberately status-transition-granular, not progress-tick-granular: per-tick progress would flood the outbox on long scans; `progress` carries whatever the transition knew, and consumers poll GET /admin/jobs/{id} for finer detail while a job is active. `jobType` additively gained 'pg-upgrade' (STATE.md Phase 4 Open item, the boot-time embedded-PG major-upgrade audit row written directly via packages/jobs's createLedger export — never a real dispatched pg-boss job, see that package's PgUpgradeJobPayload doc comment).
